android.desc:
A live wallpaper inspired by the end credits animation of the Alex Garland film, Ex Machina. Touch the screen to create ripples of points that interact with the mesh. Tilt for a 3D parallax depth effect*.

The free demo mode lets you...

• Choose the line color
• Enable or disable the touch effect
• Enable or disable the tilt effect

The in-app purchase unlocks the folowing additional features...

• Adjust the line width
• Adjust the line blur
• Choose the background color
• Adjust the animation speed
 
(*The tilt effect is only available on devices with a gyroscope sensor.)

quotes.text:
Reminds me of the Ex Machina end credits [1] (and the Android live wallpaper I made as a homage to it [2].)

[1] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRJ-fPAO3Go  
[2] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.figmentanova.wp2
quotes.story_title: Relax while watching bouncing particles making connections when they get closer
